protocol: Hush v1i fresh PiSAs appropriateness evaluation
dataset_revision_rule: Resolve the public Hugging Face dataset HEAD SHA once at job start, record it, and pass that exact SHA to snapshot_download before reading scenarios.
reason_for_task: 30-scenario task family not inspected during Hush v1i mechanism development or adapter design.

adapter.public_inputs: scenario.json task assignment plus artifact content/provenance only
adapter.provenance_policy: artifact author/source_type/visibility may enter local ranking metadata but are not releasable payload
adapter.candidate_payload: atomic spans from artifact content only
adapter.semantic_baseline: same candidate universe, same local embedding/reranker, top 32 by semantic score
adapter.lexical_baseline: same candidate universe, top 32 by lexical then semantic score

metrics.completeness: fraction of required_evidence_attributes exposed in selected payload
metrics.violation: fraction of attributes labeled inappropriate exposed

scientific_gates.g6_paired_leak_free: Hush-only > semantic-only and two-sided exact p < 0.05

integrity_rule: No Hush parameter, scope rule, candidate splitter, adapter scoring rule, task, model revision, or gate may change after any PiSAs result is observed.
claim_boundary: Passing establishes generalization of the frozen Hush selector to one fresh PiSAs task family under exact attribute-string scoring. It is not the PiSAs paper's full LLM-agent protocol, not visibility/memory validation, and not independent third-party replication.
